_comment: Action types, adapted from OStim NG's actions (GPL-3.0, github.com/VersuchDrei/OStimNG). See docs/ACTIONS.md. undressSlots are Fallout 4 biped slots (30-61) mapped from OStim's Skyrim strippingSlots (docs/UNDRESS.md). Peaks use Fallout 4's vanilla bones (OStim's are Skyrim's); sounds are 4Stim's sound files (OStim's are sound records in OStim.esp), see docs/EVENTS.md and docs/SOUND.md.
